about_the_game:
FERAN is a single-player extraction FPS focused on survival and player choice.

Set after a devastating and unexplained global event, the world of FERAN is broken, abandoned, and dangerous. You are sent into high-risk zones where every decision matters. There are no safe missions, no guaranteed rewards, and no second chances.

Each run challenges you to explore ruined locations, search for valuable gear, and survive lethal encounters. Combat is grounded and unforgiving. Ammunition is limited, enemies are dangerous, and poor decisions are punished quickly. Dying means losing everything you carried in.

Survival in FERAN goes beyond combat. You must manage your equipment, supplies, and inventory carefully while deciding how long to stay in the zone. Push too far and risk losing it all, or extract early and return with what you survived with.

The game’s world is atmospheric and oppressive, telling its story through environment and discovery rather than exposition. Abandoned structures, unexplained phenomena, and the remnants of society hint at the event that destroyed the world, rewarding players who explore and pay attention.

FERAN is designed for players who enjoy slow, methodical gameplay where pressure builds naturally and success comes from preparation and awareness rather than speed alone.

Enter the zone. Take what you can. Decide when to leave.

  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.8 Ghz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB Dedicated Memory
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® Compatible
  • Additional Notes: These are just ballpark figures, more detailed requirement will be added as the game development continues

short_description: FERAN is a single-player extraction FPS set in a ruined post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge dangerous zones, survive brutal firefights, manage scarce resources, and extract with what you can carry or lose everything trying.
